posts.text:
Grateful to spend time with Texans across this state.

The people. The land. The future.

Texas is worth fighting for.

Live Free.










Adam Loewy (@LoewyLawFirm)

Chip barnstorming the state. 

4 to 5 events per day. 

Haven’t seen an elected run this hard in some time. 

#txlege



— https://nitter.net/LoewyLawFirm/status/2053323011290218589#m

Thank you San Antonio. Live Free.

⁦⁦@laurenboebert⁩

Video

Odessa ➡️ Midland ➡️ Alpine today.

Great energy across Texas this week, grateful for the support everywhere we go.

I’m running for Attorney General because I want to fight for you, defend Texas, and preserve this state for the next generation. #LiveFree

Video

Alpine, TX. Final stop of the day.

Humbled by the support we’re seeing in every corner of Texas. This grassroots campaign is fueled by Texans who are ready to fight for its future. Grateful for every handshake, conversation, and supporter along the way. #LiveFree

Over an hour of Q&A with voters in Midland today. Texans deserve an Attorney General who’s actually practiced law, managed major legal fights, and is ready on Day One. Proud to share my legal background and vision for defending Texas. #LiveFree

Video

Great lunch in Midland talking Energy Freedom and how, as Attorney General, I’ll fight to protect Texas land, oil & gas, and private property rights from federal overreach. I’m the only candidate with experience litigating cases at the highest level including SCOTUS #LiveFree
